arguments.question: Which dated ANET disclosures, if any, establish near-term hyperscaler/enterprise order timing or capex sensitivity that could distinguish a growth-led rate-rise regime from inflation-led tightening? Please avoid inferring demand from market proxies and identify any unavailable customer-capex evidence.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether macro transmission can be linked beyond conditional mechanisms to company-specific 21- and 63-session demand/order evidence.
